caveats:
Although the de-facto authorities in Afghanistan have designated 457 admin 2 units (districts), for 2026, the humanitarian community is using 401 districts obtained from AGCHO, due to unavailablility of boundary datasets.

Names in Dari language are attributed as "prs" (Persian), as there are no standard codes for Dari.
dataset_source: Afghanistan Geodesy and Cartography Head Office (AGCHO), National Statistics and Information Authority (NSIA)
license_title: Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations (CC BY-IGO)
methodology_other:
Dataset: Government survey  
  
P-codes: National system adapted to OCHA standards
name: cod-ab-afg
notes:
Afghanistan administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 03.  
  
This dataset is structured into 2 levels:  
- Admin 1: 34 Province  
- Admin 2: 401 District  
  
  
Note: Admin 2 notes: although the de-facto authority in Afghanistan have designated 457 admin 2 units, the humanitarian community is using 401 units due to lack of boundary data for 2026  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 01 June 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 01 June 2025: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 25 March 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 May 2019: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Afghanistan](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-afghanistan).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
